title: ID0472812-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S1 313508370035] Check on logs
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Check on logs
Feedback:
temporary drop in the internet connection by OCPP before starting a charging session

additional_info.body:
Hello,
Today 16 of January around 1:20 PM CU TIME, a client tried to start a recharge with an RFID Card but the charger's screen showed “Due to a technical issue, it is impossible to start charging.” After a reboot the client had no problems starting the recharge.
Can you check the logs to help us better understand what happened?
Thank you,
Rosita Abate
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472812-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S1 313508370035] Check on logs CRM:03289000277
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
After
checking
the logs for charger
Y2 / S1 313508370035
, we have identified the cause of the message:
"Due to a technical issue, it is impossible to start charging."
The issue was caused by a
temporary drop in the internet connection
as you know this prevent the OCPP from validating the RFID card at that moment.
Following this line, we can see this log with the information "OCPP connection: OFFLINE
With best r
egards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
